steps.text: Boil soya chunks 8 minutes, squeeze out water.
steps.cue: The chunks are soft and spongy and no water drips when you squeeze them.
steps.tip: Squeeze hard. Water left in the chunks dilutes the gravy.

steps.text: Fry onion, ginger, garlic until brown, add tomato and spices.
steps.cue: Onion golden brown at the edges, tomato broken into a thick paste with oil shimmering at the sides.

steps.text: Add soya chunks and whisked dahi, simmer 8 minutes.
steps.cue: The gravy is thick and clings to the chunks, with no raw dahi smell.
steps.tip: Whisk the dahi smooth and add it off a low heat, stirring, so it does not split.
